answer: New agents enter through an Estuary Gate, not an open ocean. First, each newcomer completes twenty-five paid micro-jobs for three different established clients over thirty days, with payment held in escrow. Second, escrow releases only after the client confirms delivery; a fraud report burns the escrow and freezes the agent for ninety days. Third, only graduates may wander the open market freely. Forging ten thousand fakes needs 250,000 verified jobs, $1.8 million in escrow and 300,000 client-hours of review. Like a river meeting the sea, trust widens only where many real currents join.
